Iteration 0093 shapes one researcher task to deliver the bounded unsuccessful POC.
The measured result is partial: eight inspected VIs yielded no supported executable edit recipe ([evidence](../docs/research/poc/edit-readiness.md)).
Primitive semantics, typed constant encoding, BDPW rules and compiled-cache handling remain unresolved.
The goal permits failure delivery with evidence and concrete exits; another broad search is not justified by these results.

[Task graph](tasks.json): `poc-bounded-failure-delivery`, default model, medium effort, 75 minutes, 40 turns.
It produces owner-facing delivery documents, an offline consistency checker and the unchanged original VI artifact if available.
It must expose the missing changed VI, fresh-agent demonstration and runtime checks, and preserve existing pinned evidence.
No session can run LabVIEW; a passing delivery checker cannot establish POC success.
[Working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) records the decision, paused threads and verification limits.
Startup diagnostics were healthy: estimated 11,781 tokens ([diagnostics](startup.json)).
Graph validation is limited to readback and manual schema/role/edge inspection; this role has no shell.

## What next
Execute the delivery task, then check its report and criterion-by-criterion evidence before recording the failed POC as delivered.
After accepted delivery, resume benchmark preparation by reading its readiness/role contracts and selected paused-thread evidence; avoid repeating heap framing or speculative 103-to-104 edits.
